content: In this section, we provide a systematic analysis of our design choices. Our training methodology is the same as described in Section SECREF19 with the standard dropouts. For a thorough understanding of our design choices, we use a language model with a single layer of PRU and fix the size of embedding and hidden layers to 600. The word-level perplexities are reported on the validation sets of the PTB and the WT-2 datasets.
